We need to determine the crime(s). Facts: selling high imitation counterfeit phones with false trademark, i.e., counterfeit trademark goods. This is crime of selling counterfeit goods (假冒注册商标商品). Under Chinese criminal law, the offense is "销售假冒注册商标的商品罪". The correct statutory name without the character “罪” per correction rule: we should output only the statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we need to output "销售假冒注册商标的商品". Also possibly "侵犯商标权"? But the criminal law has specific article: Article 224 of Criminal Law: "销售假冒注册商标的商品" is a crime. So the charge is that. No other crimes described. So single charge.

Thus final answer: [罪名]销售假冒注册商标的商品<eoa>
